subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw make subagent parent-wake compaction depend only on trusted last-call or contextUsage snapshots, and should compaction entries gain a persisted closed trigger reason?
rationale: Current main has partial safeguards but the remaining fix crosses runtime compaction policy and persisted transcript schema, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Fix policy and metadata together
options.body: Gate parent-wake compaction on trusted active-context evidence, add a closed trigger reason to compaction entries, and require live subagent-yield proof before closing.

options.title: Require fresh repro first
options.body: Ask for a current-main or v2026.6.11 live reproduction before changing the transcript schema or compaction decision policy.

options.title: Only add observability first
options.body: Add trigger metadata without changing compaction behavior, then use the new evidence to decide the runtime policy later.

recommendation.title: Fix policy and metadata together
recommendation.body: Gate parent-wake compaction on trusted active-context evidence, add a closed trigger reason to compaction entries, and require live subagent-yield proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing signal for the overlapping session usage and subagent announce paths.
